callbackOrder: nativeJson promise initiated; catch handler attached synchronously
tradeoff: Inventory write completes before main role/signal assertions, not before synchronous callback cancel. Ordinary capture adds an awaited nativeJson write before assertions. This is added I/O/observation overhead without deadline/cadence/reserve changes; source QA must assess it.
promiseFailure: Immediate handler stores boolean only; main await throws closed BOOTSTRAP_INVENTORY_WRITE before assertions. No floating/unhandled promise or raw failure export.
rootIdentity: Caller supplies actual fork handle.pid; strict same snapshot validates observer self and exact root PID with PPID===process.pid, known live base/flags and strict signal0 ALIVE. No command basename ownership guess.
stateContract: Known POSIX/Darwin base states/flags only; stopped root allowed; Z/X/E-exiting and unknown states cannot confirm live. Local ps man source pinned.
pureCallerControlsLimitation: Three pure controls reproduce the unchanged fixture phase/SIGSTOP caller statements over fake edges; exact source spans are separately preserved. They do not import/register the real native fixture or provide actual native cleanup/suspension proof.
